newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says Bre-X, Barrick have no Busang deal.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says Bre-X, Barrick have no Busang deal.

text.p: Indonesian Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana said on Friday that Canada's Bre-X Minerals Ltd and Barrick Gold Corp have not completed a partnership deal to develop the Busang gold find.
"Until December 12 afternoon they had said they had agreed. But last night, there was a 180 degree change," he told reporters after meeting President Suharto. "Now they don't want to agree."
"We have been toyed with," he said. "But we will give them a chance...to continue with their negotiations. This is the wisdom of the President."
Sudjana said the companies would be given until the end of December to complete a partnership agreement.
"I will wait for them. This is also the advice of the President...give them a chance until end of December," he said. "I forget the date, but there is a limit."
"If they don't match, our laws become effective," he said without elaborating. "...We don't want to wait too long."
Sudjana also said the July parliamentary approval given to an application for contracts of work by Bre-X to explore and develop the richest parts of the find, Busang II and III, was still valid.
"Not yet," he said when asked if the parliamentary approval for the application by Bre-X had been cancelled.
"When they form a new (joint-venture) company, they need to submit a new application," he said.
"It will be automatically cancelled," he said when asked what will happen to the existing application by Bre-X.

On Wednesday, Sudjana said after appearing before a marathon parliamentary commission that the parliamentary approval had been cancelled. "We cancel it. The Bre-X contract of work will be processed from the beginning," he told reporters.
The minister on Friday did not explain the reversal of his statement on Wednesday.
